This plot is not mine, I only rent it, so I will not spend too much cash on it. Last season I put a small bit of urea when I had money from selling bananas, and the maize did better, so I will try again with maybe half a bag of urea for this small piece — I cannot afford DAP too. I will use the seed I saved from last harvest because improved seed costs money and I already missed the agro-dealer when he had stock. My husband and I will do the weeding ourselves; I may call one neighbour for one or two days at planting if my back is troubling me.
